prompt.project_info: Create a candid smartphone-style outdoor yoga portrait of an approved adult blonde woman practicing on a mat in a leafy public park.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with long wavy blonde hair, natural light skin, and a bright genuine smile looking directly at camera. She wears a white long-sleeved ribbed crop top and pastel-pink ribbed leggings, kneeling in a relaxed puppy-pose variation with forearms on the mat and head turned toward camera.
prompt.composition_elements: Low ground-level 35-50mm portrait with profile body view and frontal face. Show a light tan yoga mat on green grass, mature trees with twisting branches, dense foliage, bushes, and bright sky through the canopy.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft shaded daylight on the subject with dappled sunlight on grass and trees, soft shadows beneath the body, joyful playful relaxed outdoor-fitness mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic unedited smartphone photography, full-body vertical framing, natural depth, slight foreshortening, realistic ribbed fabric, hair strands, grass blades, and medium natural contrast.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a candid photorealistic smartphone-style portrait of an approved adult blonde woman practicing yoga on a light tan mat in a leafy public park. She has long wavy blonde hair, natural light skin, and a bright genuine smile toward the camera. Dress her in a white long-sleeved ribbed crop top and pastel-pink ribbed leggings. Show a relaxed puppy-pose variation with knees and shins on the mat, forearms supporting her, hips raised naturally, and face turned toward the lens. Use a low ground-level 35-50mm perspective, green grass, mature twisting trees, dense foliage, bushes, dappled daylight, soft shadows, and unedited realistic texture.
